PLC response: Drop motion outputs and latch E-stop state
Recovery procedure: Restore safety circuit and press Reset; restart manually

Trigger condition: Motor command active without feedback for 0.50 s
PLC response: Drop motor command and latch fault
Recovery procedure: Inspect drive/motor/feedback; clear cause and press Reset

Trigger condition: Entry sensor active continuously for 2.00 s
Recovery procedure: Clear obstruction or replace sensor; press Reset

Trigger condition: Position sensor active without entry detection
HMI alarm: Product reached position without entry detection
Recovery procedure: Inspect entry sensor/wiring and clear product; press Reset

Trigger condition: Diverter extend commanded without extended feedback for 0.80 s
Recovery procedure: Inspect actuator/air/electrical circuit; return home and press Reset

Trigger condition: Product active for 18.00 s without exit rising edge
Recovery procedure: Inspect jam/sensors/conveyor; clear product and press Reset

Trigger condition: Diverter home and extended limits both active
Recovery procedure: Inspect limit wiring/adjustment; clear contradiction and press Reset
